title: The Story Continues – 16 Years of Hope
story:
December 24 is a special day for another reason, too. On this day in 2010, a young j-hope left his hometown of Gwangju and moved to Seoul to pursue his dreams. Today, we celebrate the 16th anniversary of that important step – the beginning of a journey that would take him from a young dancer with big dreams to an artist known and loved around the world.

And here we are, at the final page of our Advent journey.

Over the past 24 days, we have followed the story of a boy from Gwangju who grew into a dancer, a songwriter, a performer, an artist, and an important part of BTS. We have travelled through his early years, discovered the meaning behind his name, explored his music and creative vision, celebrated his achievements, and seen the dedication and kindness behind the person we know as j-hope.

We have watched him step onto some of the world's biggest stages, build his own musical identity, share his art with new audiences, and return to the stage with BTS for a new chapter called ARIRANG. Through every change and every challenge, one thing has remained: his determination to keep growing, keep creating, and give his very best.

But this story was never only about achievements, records, performances, or awards. It is also about the connection between an artist and the people who have walked beside him. j-hope has often expressed how much ARMY means to him. And in a message shared on Weverse on November 15, 2026, he wrote: "I'm happy to be your singer. Truly! Do I need to say more? I'll love you forever!"

Perhaps that is the perfect way to end this Advent calendar. Because behind every stage, every song, every milestone, and every new beginning, there is a connection that continues to inspire both sides.

So today, as we celebrate Christmas, we also celebrate 16 years since j-hope took that life-changing step from Gwangju to Seoul. A young man's dream became a remarkable journey, and we are grateful to have witnessed so many chapters of it.

Thank you for opening each day, discovering another part of j-hope's story, and celebrating his journey with us. The calendar may be coming to an end, but his story is still being written. There are new songs to hear, new stages to see, new dreams to follow, and countless moments still waiting to happen.

Merry Christmas, happy 16th anniversary of j-hope's journey to Seoul, and may we keep walking alongside him as his story continues. TILL THE END WITH J-HOPE ❤️‍🔥
surpriseDescription: Let's end our Advent journey with a little Christmas cheer! Enjoy j-hope and Jin sharing the festive spirit in their “Feliz Navidad” video. Merry Christmas! 🎄
